in_marathi.name: Haridas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Haridas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Haridas means 'God's servant' in Sanskrit. This name is derived from the words 'hari' meaning 'God' and 'das' meaning 'servant'. Haridas is revered in Hindu mythology as a devoted devotee of Lord Vishnu.
